Scene:
一个爬山的男人正好看到神农的麻烦，然后给了他一些药。神农最终他的小镇回到，跟别的人分享他的发现。你认为神农的故事真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处：相信不相信中药对身体有好处了

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处：这就要看你相不相信中药对身体有没有好处了，This structure needs an alternative question after 看, and 了 is part of the fixed concluding structure. [teacher rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan_le]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处：这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处了，This fixed structure ends with “了”; here it is part of the structure rather than a marker of completed action. [teacher rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan_le]

output.reason: Run 1 addresses the required 相不相信 alternative structure as well as 了, while Run 2 only adds 了 and leaves the teacher-corrected error unresolved.
